title: Meet the Drawbridge Generation: 2026 Youth Report
discussion_signal: The youth-report relay describes widespread AI use alongside low trust in AI for personal advice, continuing reliance on family and friends, and anxiety about financial stability and homeownership. The framing positions trust as relational even as digital access expands.
linked_research_question: How can young people adopt AI and digital information while retaining a trust boundary around intimate, financial, and identity-relevant decisions?
limits: The report is commissioned and presented by a retailer
Survey measures and sample details require primary-report review
